## Why

Fleet coverage initiative round 8 remains below the 90% objective (baseline 85% in `config/coverage-baseline.json`; measured ~77% on recent Gate runs). Workflows is the fleet's largest remaining gap.

## Scope

Add a discriminating regression in `tests/scripts/test_issue_format.py` for an uncovered branch in `.github/scripts/issue_format.py`.

## Non-Goals

Do not modify `templates/consumer-repo/` or `.github/workflows/*.yml` dispatch, keepalive, or routing logic.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add unit test in `tests/scripts/test_issue_format.py` covering untracked branch conditions in `.github/scripts/issue_format.py`.
- [ ] Run `pytest tests/scripts/test_issue_format.py` and verify coverage increase.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/scripts/test_issue_format.py` exits 0 on Workflows main.
- [ ] Line coverage of `.github/scripts/issue_format.py` is maintained or improved.
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_issue_format.py -q` runs cleanly in a fresh clone.
